title: Neue Ofen-Einrichtung, von Hrn. Wilhelm Siemens
version: Polytechnisches Journal vol. 146, article XLI, p. 174, German transcription of Civil Engineer and Architect’s Journal, August 1857
lineage: Contemporary German journal transcribes an August 1857 English report. It describes alternating refractory regeneration and says the furnace had been operating in the named steelworks; its six-day comparison begins 13 July 1857. The English original was not separately obtained. No claim is made that the installation melted steel.

passages.note: Full article: alternating regenerators; Marriott and Atkinson Sheffield rolling-furnace use; Atkinson’s six-day comparison beginning 13 July 1857
